unlisted_practices: Restrict LLM use in mental healthcare to supervised, assistive tasks and do not delegate clinical judgement to LLMs.
Do not use LLMs as substitutes for professional mental healthcare or deploy them unsupervised for clinical advice.
Avoid overambitious deployment of LLMs in mental healthcare until the technology is demonstrably safe and reliable.
Require explicit accountability when LLM errors occur in mental healthcare.
